info.title: BTPanel Developer API
info.description: Primary OpenAPI document for BTPanel developer APIs validated against the current SDK and live panel probes.

servers.description: Root BTPanel base URL. Do not append the panel entry path used for browser login pages.

post.description:
Get system overview.

Real request: `POST /system?action=GetSystemTotal`.

Auth mode: developer API signature (`request_time` + `request_token`).

Get disk usage list.

Real request: `POST /system?action=GetDiskInfo`.

Auth mode: developer API signature (`request_time` + `request_token`).

Get network metrics.

Real request: `POST /system?action=GetNetWork`.

Auth mode: developer API signature (`request_time` + `request_token`).

Check panel update.

Real request: `POST /ajax?action=UpdatePanel`.

Auth mode: developer API signature (`request_time` + `request_token`).

Get pending task count.

Real request: `POST /ajax?action=GetTaskCount`.

Auth mode: developer API signature (`request_time` + `request_token`).

List site categories.

Real request: `POST /site?action=get_site_types`.

Auth mode: developer API signature (`request_time` + `request_token`).

List websites (legacy data endpoint).

Real request: `POST /data?action=getData&table=sites`.

Auth mode: developer API signature (`request_time` + `request_token`). This route is kept for compatibility.

Status: deprecated compatibility route. Do not prefer this endpoint on current panel versions.
